reviews.comment: Do not take him, i'm pretty sure he's only available in the spring but i wasn't able to get anyone else and i thought he was a better choice over the other low rated professors and i was so wrong. his teaching style is all over the place and make sits very hard to study for tests

Philipp Illeditsch was really great! Take him if you can! I think he usually only lectures in the spring. He is super fair about giving partial credit on the exams and problem sets. Incredibly smart and makes everything understandable. It was a blessing having Illeditsch vs the other professor - 63 average on their first exam vs. 90 on ours.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Philipp is the best prof you could get for FINC 351 at Texas A&M! Here's a quote from Philipp that shows you why he's the GOAT... "It's not that I really care about seeing the correct numerical answer on your tests, I really just want you to show me your thought process so I can determine your understanding of the concepts." Lots of partial credit.
